basis: API-equivalent weights named in spec_pentacle__usage_rollup_and_calibration_2026_10 (Claude) and spec_pentacle__usage_codex_rollup_and_calibration_2026_10 (Codex); a weighted proxy for limit consumption, not billing.

codex_frontier.assumption: named API-equivalent assumption: frontier Codex tier; cached input at 10 % of input; cache writes at the input rate; reasoning is part of output and never priced separately

codex_standard.assumption: named API-equivalent assumption: standard Codex tier at 1/4 of frontier

codex_small.assumption: named API-equivalent assumption: small Codex tier at 1/20 of frontier

<synthetic>.assumption: Claude Code synthetic messages carry no model usage

gpt-6-sol.assumption: Sol priced as the frontier tier

gpt-6.1-sol.assumption: Sol 6.1 priced as the frontier tier

gpt-6-astra.assumption: Astra priced as the frontier tier

gpt-reserve.assumption: reserve model priced as the frontier tier

gpt-6-luna.assumption: Luna priced as the standard tier

gpt-5.6-luna.assumption: Luna 5.6 priced as the standard tier

codex-auto-review.assumption: auto-review priced as the standard tier

gpt-5.6-terra.assumption: Terra priced as the small tier
